repo.name: Twelve Standalone
repo.description: Unofficial, automatically rebuilt APKs of the LineageOS Twelve music player, packaged for any Android 11+ device.

apps.description:
Twelve is the LineageOS music player: a simple and lightweight local-music
player with support for queue management, favorites, a widget, Hi-res audio
and audio effects.

This version is repackaged for use on any Android 11+ device. It is built
automatically from the upstream LineageOS source whenever a new commit lands
on the lineage-24.0 branch. Note that this build is signed by the maintainer
of this repository, so it will not update in place over builds from other
sources.
apps.name: Twelve (standalone)
apps.summary: A simple and lightweight music player from LineageOS
